'''Drash-So''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Selvatas system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. During the [[Second Imperial Civil War]], the [[One Sith]] ran a prison labor camp on the planet. [[Ania Solo]] and [[Ramid]] were two of the inmates there. The camp was [[Liberation of the Drash-So labor camp|liberated]] by the [[Empire-in-exile|Empire-in-Exile]] at the end of the war.
